series: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry Predictions; IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda Predictions

futurescapes.name: Worldwide IT Industry
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2016 Predictions — Leading Digital Transformation to Scale
futurescapes.note: Table of contents read from an Internet Archive copy. Each headline starts with an IDC label, kept in idc_label.

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2016 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Only four predictions found, in a CIO.com article (December 18, 2015) promoting the IDC webcast. The first is introduced as 'IDC predicts that ...'. IDC document number and the full list not found.

entries.quote: By the End of 2017, Two-Thirds of the CEOs of Global 2000 Enterprises Will Have Digital Transformation at the Center of Their Corporate Strategy
entries.subject: Digital transformation in corporate strategy
entries.metric: share of G2000 CEOs with DX at the center of corporate strategy

entries.quote: By 2017, Over 50% of Organizations' IT Spending Will Be for 3rd Platform Technologies, Solutions, and Services, Rising to Over 60% by 2020
entries.subject: 3rd Platform share of IT spending
entries.metric: share of organizations' IT spending on 3rd Platform technologies

entries.quote: By 2018, at Least Half of IT Spending Will Be Cloud Based, Reaching 60% of All IT Infrastructure and 60-70% of All Software, Services, and Technology Spending by 2020
entries.subject: Cloud share of IT spending
entries.metric: share of IT spending that is cloud based
entries.note: Also: by 2020, 60% of IT infrastructure and 60-70% of software, services and technology spending.

entries.quote: By 2018, Enterprises Pursuing DX Strategies Will More than Double Software Development Capabilities; 2/3 of Their Coders Will Focus on Strategic DX Apps/Services
entries.subject: Software development capacity
entries.metric: change in software development capabilities of enterprises with DX strategies
entries.note: Also: two-thirds of their coders on strategic DX apps.

entries.quote: By 2018, Enterprises with DX Strategies Will Expand External Data Sources by at Least 3- to 5-Fold and Delivery of Data to the Market by 100-Fold or More
entries.subject: Enterprise data pipelines
entries.metric: expansion of external data sources by enterprises with DX strategies
entries.note: Also: delivery of data to market up 100-fold or more.

entries.quote: By 2018, There Will Be 22 Billion IoT Devices Installed, Driving the Development of Over 200,000 New IoT Apps and Services
entries.subject: IoT devices
entries.note: Also: over 200,000 new IoT apps and services.

entries.quote: By 2018, Over 50% of Developer Teams Will Embed Cognitive Services in Their Apps (vs. 1% Today), Providing U.S. Enterprises $60+ Billion Annual Savings by 2020
entries.subject: Cognitive services in apps
entries.metric: share of developer teams embedding cognitive services
entries.note: Also: U.S. enterprises save $60+ billion a year by 2020.

entries.quote: By 2018, Over 50% of Enterprises Will Create and/or Partner with Industry Cloud Platforms to Distribute Their Own Innovations, Source Others'
entries.subject: Industry cloud platforms
entries.metric: share of enterprises creating or partnering with industry cloud platforms

entries.quote: By 2018, 80% of B2C and 60% of B2B Enterprises Will Overhaul Their "Digital Front Door" to Support 1,000–10,000 Times More Customers and Customer Touch Points
entries.subject: Digital front door
entries.metric: share of B2C enterprises overhauling their digital front door
entries.note: Also: 60% of B2B enterprises; support for 1,000-10,000 times more customers and touch points.

entries.quote: By 2020, More than 30% of the IT Vendors Will Not Exist as We Know Them Today, Requiring Realignment of Preferred Vendor Relationships
entries.subject: IT vendor landscape
entries.metric: share of IT vendors that will not exist as known today

entries.quote: by 2018, 35% of IT resources will be spent to support the creation of new digital revenue streams
entries.subject: IT resources for digital revenue
entries.metric: share of IT resources spent to support new digital revenue streams
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: By 2017, 80% of global CIOs will initiate a data transformation and governance framework to turn information into a competitive business differentiator
entries.subject: Data transformation and governance
entries.metric: share of global CIOs initiating a data transformation and governance framework
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: By 2016, 70% of IT organizations will shift their focus to advanced 'contain and control' security away from a perimeter mentality
entries.subject: Contain-and-control security
entries.metric: share of IT organizations shifting to contain-and-control security
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

entries.quote: By 2017, 60% of digital transformation initiatives will not be able to scale due to a lack of a strategic architecture
entries.subject: Digital transformation scaling failures
entries.metric: share of DX initiatives unable to scale for lack of strategic architecture
entries.note: Order in the source is not IDC's prediction number.

notes: IT Industry complete; CIO Agenda partial (4 found).
